{{Quote|They have always been aggressive to a fault, and their chieftain, Mavrix, trains each of his warriors personally. Failures are hunted for sport.|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="TOR:IFMR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|[INTRO] Flashpoint: Mandalorian Raiders|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref>}}
'''Clan Varad''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|You are aware of the Empire's pact with the Mandalorians. The mercenary clans supported us during the war, and we paid them well. But the treaty has made them restless. Now Clan Varad has broken with the Mandalorian leadership and declared ''Akaan'gaan''—the search for battle.'' [...] ''I admire their passion, but their methods are self-destructive. Clan Varad has begun a series of raids against both Republic and Imperial colonies, slaughtering our soldiers and demanding tribute. These traitors must be eliminated.|Darth Malgus|audio=ClanVarad-Malgus-TOR.flac|<ref name="TOR:IFMR" />}}
[[File:Clan_Varad.png|thumb|right|200px|Clan Varad members aboard ''Allusis'']]
Varad established a number of secret bases throughout the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> eventually going rogue and attacking [[Planet/Legends|planets]] controlled by both governments. Members of Clan Varad developed an aggressive and violent reputation among the Mandalorian community, owed to decades of raiding and plundering from their hidden compounds.<ref name="Codex" />

Clan Varad was led by [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Mavrix Varad]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] considered [[Blood/Legends|bloodthirsty]] by his peers. Forcing his kinsmen to face demanding combat trials, those who failed to meet Varad's standards were used for [[Unarmed combat/Legends|sparring]] or even hunting practice for the clan's younger members. However, those that succeeded were often rewarded with a substantial influx of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weaponry from the clan's latest pillage.<ref name="Codex" />

During the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Cold War, Mavrix Varad clashed on a personal level with the Mandalorians' reigning ''[[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mand'alor]]'',<ref name="Codex" /> [[Mandalore the Vindicated]],<ref name="Mandalore">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref> who thought of Mavrix as little more than "a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] foaming at the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]." Clan Varad members became unwelcome at the Mandalorian-held stronghold of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], and it wasn't long after that Varad openly turned on the ''Mand'alor''. Seeking combat, Clan Varad willingly struck at both Republic and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] targets alike.<ref name="Codex" /> The clan even stealing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Allusis]]'', declaring ''[[Akaan'gaan]]'', and used it to attack and plunder vulnerable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TOR:IFMR" /> In response, both the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] sent strike teams to [[Battle for the Allusis|board and seize]] the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Mavrix Varad and several members of Clan Varad were slain during the ensuing hostilities<ref name="Mandalorian Raiders" />. The remaining surviving members onboard the ship were captured and re-accepted into the other Clans' lowest ranks for their dishonorable betrayal.<ref name="TOR:IFMR" />

[[File:ClanVarad62.png|thumb|left|250px|Clan Varad members aboard the ''Champion's Glory''.]]
However, Clan Varad continued to exist in some capacity. They repainted their armor from red and gray to purple and yellow.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> members of Clan Varad, now under the leadership of Mavrix's nephew,<ref name="BrokenbladeCodex" /> [[Tyrus Brokenblade]], joined up with [[Heta Kol]]'s organization known as the [[Hidden Chain]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]]. Additionally, they began donning purple and yellow armor as opposed to their original red and gray. With their [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the ''[[Champion's Glory]]'', they aided Kol in an [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] on the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', and helped make off with the [[Clan Cadera banner|banner]] of [[Clan Cadera]]. Their own banner, shown on their warship and on [[Ruhnuk]], is gold with purple and black accents. It features [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] text translating to "that which does not kill us" as well as the [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaur]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />

[[File:Clan_Varad_on_Ruhnuk.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Clan Varad members on Ruhnuk.]]
During a [[Raid on Kessan's Landing|mission]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], Tyrus Brokenblade clashed with [[Sa'har Kateen]], losing his hand in the process, and was captured by the [[Eternal Alliance]], leaving Varad leaderless once more.<ref name="TOR:SC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

Thousands of years later, during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Clan Varad gave rise to the skilled Mandalorian warrior by the name of [[Shyla Varad/Legends|Shyla Varad]]. As the Imperials occupied the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], Shyla became disconnected from her people but eventually took up arms against the Empire.<ref name="Jabba'sRealm" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Possible_Clan_Varad_Insignia.png|thumb|180px|Possible insignia of Clan Varad, seen on a [[ML-39 Brute Patrol Ship]] within the Flashpoint]]
Clan Varad and its leader, Mavrix, are the main antagonists of the "Mandalorian Raiders" flashpoint, playable by both the Republic and Empire factions in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Players control one of the strike teams sent to seize the Allusis and end Clan Varad's threat.<ref name="Mandalorian Raiders" />
